name: Moonlit Wizardry
source:
The MC, Nova, was a depressed novelist with writer's block. On a certain moonlit night, a wizard called Wizard came to his balcony, claimed that he wanted to cheer Nova up with magic! And Nova's little adventure with Wizard started.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/moonlit-wizardry]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主持人诺瓦是一位患有写作障碍、抑郁的小说家。某个月夜，一位名叫巫师的巫师来到他的阳台，声称要用魔法让诺瓦振奋起来！诺瓦与巫师的小冒险开始了。

[来自[url=https://altila.itch.io/moonlit-wizardry]itch.io[/url]]
